guiding_policy: Code owns the routing decisions for TODO management; AI text never decides which bucket an item belongs to. Validators are deterministic regexes; framing checks fail closed.
desired_outcome: After this slice ships, every `[Thought]`-tagged TODO item entering the system passes a framing validator that runs in code. The user sees a validator error inline if framing is broken, and does not see silently-malformed items downstream.
desired_solution: Add `validate-framing` subcommand to `todo.py` (6 regex checks). Add `--validate-framing` flag on `todo.py add` and a `--phase` flag that suppresses writes during specific phases. Add `reframe --supersede`, `mark-in-progress`, `audit-coverage` subcommands. All checks deterministic; no AI in the validator path.
metrics: OMTM: framing-validator pass rate on `[Thought]`-tagged items = 1.0 (code-enforced; line in sand 1.0). Secondary: percentage of `[Thought]` items with a linked plan file ≥0.95. Decision rule: revise validator regex or add new check on any miss.
